name: Magnus Vestergaard
bio:
Magnus Vestergaard's entry into motorsport wasn't through the usual avenues. A former military police officer specializing in threat assessment and security protocols, Magnus transitioned his skills to the high-stakes world of racing after a chance encounter with a team owner seeking to bolster their security detail. His disciplined background and meticulous approach quickly made him an invaluable asset.

At Trackhouse Racing, Magnus is responsible for overseeing all aspects of security, from trackside safety to data protection. His unflappable demeanor and deep understanding of risk management allow him to anticipate and mitigate potential threats before they escalate. He is known for his dedication to creating a secure and stable environment for the team to operate at their best. What sets Magnus apart is his ability to blend cutting-edge security technology with traditional policing strategies, ensuring a comprehensive and proactive defense against all vulnerabilities.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Magnus is a tall, broad-shouldered man with a stern but professional demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with security protocols and contingency plans.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his desk, even when it appears spotless.
Prefers to communicate via secure messaging apps, even for casual conversations.
